title: Certify one exact 1.1.3 IFX candidate on Windows and offline Linux
goal: Freeze and independently certify the C1-C5 combined IFX bundle across Windows and pinned offline Linux without human-approval or cutover claims.
acceptanceCriteria: Same-source Windows-full and offline Linux-complete pass with SDK 10.0.303, identical published Package hash and pinned Linux image identity.
Seven fresh lock families and a native Linux evaluated graph are checked for lineage and cross-platform semantic parity before one manifest/Profile hash is frozen.

Both platforms consume identical bundle and published 1.1.3 archive bytes; platform-native receipts have identical archive, manifest and file identities; direct Pre, direct Post and dependency Post pass with expected module/claim counts, zero findings and immutable roots.
Independent clean, violation, missing-input and zero-match controls cover every represented detector family; tamper and capability controls fail closed with zero baselines.
Formal Pre, isolated package regression and exact committed Formal Diff pass; no human review, operational install, Web UI practice or IFX cutover is claimed.
